figurative_meaning_en: Whimsical demand; acting as one pleases
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খেয়ালখুশি করে সিদ্ধান্ত নেয় না।
জীবনে খেয়ালখুশি করে চললে সফলতা আসবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He doesn't make decisions on a whim.
Living life whimsically won't lead to success.
note: Often used to advise against impulsive actions in Bengali culture
